grid-line-light.purpose: Background technical grid only, light theme.

themes.scope: Tokens are declared on body.tb (home page only, web/home.css). Tool pages still use web/style.css; this system is their migration target.

display.purpose: Hero title only, uppercase, max 11ch; one accent word may take the lime stroke.

title.purpose: Tool card names (1.75rem), benefit titles (1.6rem), modal titles (2rem).

title-sm.purpose: Rows of the hero tool index.

wordmark.purpose: TecnoBear text beside the isotipo; never rotates.

engraving.purpose: Brand motto on the dial ring, under the hero plate, and in the footer; tracking 0.28-0.32em.

body.purpose: Running text; hero lead at clamp(1rem, 1.25vw, 1.125rem), max 54ch.

body-sm.purpose: Card descriptions, benefit copy, footer links.

label.purpose: Buttons, filter chips, account buttons; uppercase 0.06-0.1em.

caption.purpose: Category lines, photo tag, modal tool tag; uppercase 0.1-0.14em.

shadows.name: isotipo-seat
shadows.purpose: Plate-colored collar with a 1px rule seating the spinning isotipo (6px/7px under 640px).

shadows.name: modal-drop
shadows.purpose: Open dialogs, over a flat rgba(5, 8, 9, .78) backdrop without blur.

motion.name: ease-machined
motion.purpose: Hover slides, index indent, card photo zoom, entrance.

motion.name: isotipo-spin
motion.purpose: The only rotating element; playback rate 3x on hover/focus of its brand area or the hero plate; footer isotipo still.

motion.name: entrance
motion.value: opacity .7s, translate .9s (18px rise), 70ms stagger in groups of four
motion.purpose: Below-the-fold cards and benefit cells, once; skipped under reduced motion or without IntersectionObserver.

motion.name: state-color
motion.purpose: Border, text and fill color changes on controls.

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: Cards and benefits to 2 columns; filters 4-up grid; search stacks.

breakpoints.name: nav
breakpoints.purpose: Hamburger nav; hero stacks with plate first (max 420px).

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Single column; 60px nav; 32px grid; plate 220px; full-width CTAs.

geometry.bevel-rule: 1px line rotated 45deg along each cut, length bevel*1.4142
geometry.corner-brackets: 22px, 2px lime, top-left and bottom-right of the hero plate
geometry.icons: inline SVG sprite, stroke 1.6 (1.4 in benefit strip), square caps, miter joins, 16-20px (30px benefits)

brandAssets.rule: Original file, never redrawn or recolored; only the isotipo image rotates.

narrative.overview:
TecnoBear's interface is the faceplate of a digital-fabrication bench. The page is a dark machined floor ruled with a near-invisible 1px technical grid; content sits on flat plates bounded by 1px rules, each plate with a single 45° bevel cut into one corner. The tools read as machine cards, the hero object is a graduated turntable dial with the original TecnoBear isotipo spinning at its center, and the brand motto is engraved around the ring. Nothing floats, glows or rounds into a pill; structure comes from rules, tonal plates and condensed stamped capitals.

The system is dark by default and supports a light variant (`html[data-theme="light"]`) because the site-wide theme toggle must keep working; both variants share every rule below and differ only in the neutral and accent-stroke tokens. Density is calm: one 1360px container, generous section breaks, and grids of four that collapse to two and then one.

Scope: this industrial system currently applies to the home page (`web/index.html`, `web/home.css`, `web/home.js`, catalog data in `web/herramientas.js`). It is the target system for the tool pages (macetas, mate, sopa, topper, admin), which still carry the older shared `web/style.css` look; that older look is not an authority for new work.
keyCharacteristics: Dark machined floor (dark default) with a 48px technical grid of 1px lime-tinted lines at 4.5% opacity (32px cells under 640px).
Flat plates, 1px rules, one 45° bevel per plate with the diagonal rule drawn on the cut.
Lime as the single action/active color and the color of instrument markings; the logo's pale yellow reserved for the brand.
Barlow Condensed uppercase for every heading; Inter for everything else.
Square corners: 2px on controls, 0 on plates; no pills.
One moving signature: the isotipo rotates like a lathe chuck; text never moves.

rules.name: The Two-Lime Rule
rules.body: Lime has two jobs and two tokens: `lima` is a fill (always #c5f05b, always with `lima-ink` on it); the accent used as text or stroke follows the theme (`lima` in dark, `acento-light` in light). Never put lime text on a light plate.

rules.name: The Instrument-Marking Rule
rules.body: Lime appears only on actions, active/pressed/focused states, and small instrument markings. It never fills a section, a card or a large surface.

rules.name: The Brand-Yellow Rule
rules.body: Isotipo Yellow belongs to the brand (motto, Pro badge, the logo itself). It never signals UI state.

rules.name: The Stamped Title Rule
rules.body: Every h1–h3 is Barlow Condensed uppercase with balanced wrapping; nothing else uses Barlow Condensed except the wordmark, index rows, the results count numeral and the engraving.

rules.name: The Engraving Rule
rules.body: Wide tracking (0.28em and up) is reserved for the brand motto. Labels track at 0.06–0.14em, never wider.

rules.name: The Ruled-Not-Raised Rule
rules.body: Cards and controls never gain a shadow or lift on hover; they answer with a brighter rule, a lime bevel line, or a lime stroke. A 1px press (`translateY(1px)`) on buttons is the only movement.

rules.name: The One Bevel Rule
rules.body: One cut corner per object (the hero plate's diagonal pair is the single exception), always 45°, always with its diagonal rule. No pills, no rounded cards, no radius above 2px except the isotipo.

dos: Do build every new surface on the dark floor with the 48px grid, flat Plate containers and 1px Rule borders, and wire the light variant through the same tokens under `html[data-theme="light"]`.
Do cut exactly one 45° bevel per plate with `clip-path` and draw its 1px diagonal rule.
Do keep lime to actions, active/pressed/focus states and small instrument markings; use `lima-ink` on lime fills and the theme's accent stroke for lime text.
Do set every heading in Barlow Condensed uppercase and everything else in Inter, both self-hosted.
Do use the original logo file (`web/assets/marca/logo-tecnobear-original.png`) untouched; only the isotipo image rotates.
Do use 1.6px square-capped, miter-joined line icons from the inline sprite, 16–20px (30px in the benefit strip).
Do keep text AA on its plate in both themes and show the 2px lime focus outline on every control.
donts: Don't use pills, rounded cards or any radius above 2px; the only circles are the isotipo and its dial.
Don't lift cards with shadows or translate them on hover; answer hover with a brighter rule or lime stroke.
Don't add outer glows, neon halos or backdrop blur.
Don't fill large areas with lime, or use Isotipo Yellow for UI state.
Don't redraw, recolor, rotate the text of, or replace the logo with an emoji or icon.
Don't treat the older `web/style.css` look of the tool pages as a reference for new work.
